name: Safe wrapper negotiation requires an external wrapper fixture

applicability.reason: Supported. C041 lets a wrapper pin supported C ABI versions but REQUIRES it to report its underlying C ABI version and to FAIL CLOSED when the negotiated table cannot satisfy its safety assumptions. The corpus had C fixtures only, so there was no wrapper to report or to fail. `cpp_wrapper.cpp` is compiled AS C++ by the build and supplies one: it reports the negotiated major and minor, which this row observes, and a companion scenario shows it refusing a major it does not pin while retaining nothing from the rejected negotiation, since a wrapper that kept a half-negotiated attachment would not be failing closed.
